# dsh-matlab-runner

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that puts a VS Code–shaped MATLAB panel in the right
sidebar: edit `.m` co

de, press **⌘/Ctrl+Enter**, watch the console, open figures
inline, keep a warm MATLAB session betwe

en runs, browse several folders like
MATLAB's add-to-path list, and inspect/assign workspace variabl

runs, browse several folders like
MATLAB's add-to-path list, and inspect/assign workspace variables.

`dsh-matlab-runner` is a *UI* plugin: the host half spawns MATLAB with the
system user's permissions

(not the agent's sandbox) and the browser half gives
you an editor + runner + workspace inspector.

Unlike the MCP-based MATLAB
plugins, it is not an agent tool wrapper — the agent does get a `matlab_

run`
tool, but the panel is the product.
Two halves in one package:
| Half | File | What it does |
| Host | `lib/index.js`, `lib/runner.js` | Owns the persistent MATLAB session and the run registry,

serves `/matlab/api/*`, and registers the `matlab_run` agent tool. |
| Browser | `lib/client.js` | A
page-type sidebar tab (editor, gutter, script picker, Run/Stop/Save, live console, figure previews,
settings) plus a guide card and the `matlab-runner.open` shortcut. |

*A real run: file tree + variables on the left, editor in the middle, live console
below, exported f

igures as thumbnails. Dividers resize the tree, the variables pane
and the console; settings are one

mbnails. Dividers resize the tree, the variables pane
and the console; settings are one click away.*
| Settings | Narrow sidebar |
## Two run modes

- **`session` (default)** — one long-lived `matlab -nodesktop -nosplash` process
fed through stdin.

After the first boot (≈6–9 s) a run costs **~10–30 ms**, the
prompt keeps your variables between run

s, and figure windows **really open on
the desktop** while the panel also shows the exported PNG. Ou

tput is streamed
into the console while the script is still running.
- **`batch`** — `matlab -batch`

per run, headless, exits with the script
(15–20 s per call, no windows). Kept for CI-ish, leave-not

s, exits with the script
(15–20 s per call, no windows). Kept for CI-ish, leave-nothing-behind work.

The session is shared between the sidebar and the agent tool, so what the model
runs and what you ty
pe land in the same MATLAB workspace.
## Why this runs when the agent's shell cannot

MATLAB needs to write `~/Library/Application Support/MathWorks` before it will
start. A sandboxed sh

ell (`workspace-write`) makes `matlab -batch` exit 1 with
an empty console, and a PTY tab owned by t

he agent is subject to the same
sandbox. The host half spawns MATLAB with `node:child_process` from

the host
process, i.e. with the system user's permissions, independently of the agent's
sandbox mode

— so this panel runs MATLAB without switching the session to Full
access.

For the desktop app, whose profile is owned by the Electron application, use the
bundled script — it

copies the payload into the profile, wires the dependency and
the `dsh.profile.bundles` row, seeds
the config, and re-composes the plugin:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The official desktop app owns its profile, so the script copies the payload
into `~/.dsh/profiles/de

sktop/node_modules/dsh-matlab-runner`, adds the
dependency and the `dsh.profile.bundles` row, seeds

the config, and re-composes
the plugin's Loader entry.

About that last step: the app watches `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`, so
**dropping the bund

le row and putting it back reloads the plugin from disk** —
no app restart, no lost session. `bin/re
load-host.sh` does exactly that:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then reload the page (⌘/Ctrl+R) so the browser half updates too. A full app
restart is only needed i
f the tab still shows the old panel.
## Open it

Right sidebar → the add control (`+`) → the **MATLAB 运行器 / MATLAB runner**
card. After the first vis

it the tab is in the strip; ⌘/Ctrl+Shift+M opens it
from anywhere (web builds: ⌘/Ctrl+Shift+Alt+M).
## What the panel does

- **File tree** (`⌸ 文件`) — browse `workdir` from the panel, expand folders
lazily, click any text fi

le to open it in the editor (`↑ 上一级` walks up,
`刷新` re-reads). Only files with a text extension are

editable; anything else
reports `binary`.
- **Editor** with a line-number gutter, MATLAB syntax high

lighting (keywords,
strings, numbers, comments), no autocorrect, `Tab` = two spaces.
- **Run** (⌘/Ct

rl+Enter) writes the buffer to
`<workdir>/.dsh-matlab-runner/<stem>.m` and runs it in the persistent

session.
- **Script picker** — every `.m` in `scriptDir` plus every unsaved draft.
Picking one load

s it into the editor. **＋ New** starts a blank buffer, and
**every buffer is remembered** (per file

path, plus each draft) so switching
files or tabs never throws typed code away.
- **Multiple folders

** — the tree header has a folder picker plus a **+** button.
`+` mounts any absolute path (`~` work

s) as an extra tree root, exactly like
MATLAB's "add to path" list; mounts are persisted in `matlab-

runner.json` as
`extraRoots` and can be removed again from the same row. Mounted folders are
browsab

le and editable, but a run's working directory still follows the
workspace (relative paths stay anch

ored to the script being run).
- **Variable editor** — double-click any row in the variables panel t

o open the
value; edit the literal and **写回工作区 / Write back** assigns it with
`evalin('base', '<name

> = <literal>;')`, so it really replaces the MATLAB
variable (the panel refreshes right after). Nume

rics are shown with
`mat2str`, anything else through `evalc('disp(x)')`.
- **Stop / ■** aborts the c

urrent script (in session mode this restarts the
MATLAB session; the next run boots it again).
- **S

ave** writes a real script to `<scriptDir>/<name>.m`.
- Console streams stdout/stderr live, then sho

ws exit code, elapsed time, and the
script path. Errors print `getReport(e,'extended')`, so line num

bers survive.
- **Autosave** — after a run that exits cleanly the buffer is written back to
disk: op

ened files go to their own path, drafts are saved as a new script
[该节后续省略]
